summary: Phase 149O.10.1 -- HSCE-001 Narrow Contract Repair: narrow contract-repair-only phase (no production implementation, no HATP-001/RAE-001 amendment, no CLI implementation, no hardware provisioning, no signing execution, no Permission Broker change, no rollback dispatch behavior change). Ran the full required initial inspection (git status/log, pcae health/check/status coherence/doctor task-memory/push check/runtime inspect, telegram notify status, phase-report show --latest and reconcile --phase-id 149O.10) and confirmed the expected baseline: 149O.10 completed/complete/pushed/consistent, HSCE-001 v1.0 NOT VERIFIED due to one BLOCKING finding (149O.10-F-3), HATP production NOT READY, runtime Observed/observe/unavailable. Read HSCE-001's full text directly (not trusting 149O.10's own summary) and rollback_approval_evidence.py's exclusive-creation-registration logic (os.open with O_CREAT|O_EXCL) as production precedent. Repaired HSCE-REQ-052: replaced the check-then-os.replace publication algorithm (which 149O.10 independently demonstrated does not guarantee SC-7 under concurrent writers, since os.replace is unconditional on POSIX and provides no exclusivity) with atomic hard-link publication -- write the candidate envelope to a temp file in the same envelopes/ directory, fsync, then attempt os.link(temp_path, final_path); a successful link establishes the exclusive-publication winner in a single atomic filesystem operation with no partially-visible intermediate state ever possible at the destination; FileExistsError means this writer lost the race, and (after checking the destination is not a symlink, per HSCE-REQ-057) the loser compares its own candidate's canonical bytes against the now-persisted canonical envelope -- byte-identical is idempotent success, byte-different is evidence_conflict; any other OSError (unsupported filesystem, cross-device pair) fails closed as evidence_persistence_failure, with no fallback to os.replace or any other overwrite-capable primitive under any condition. Selected atomic hard-link publication over a separate exclusive-claim/creation-registry directory (RAE-001's own two-file bindings/+creation-registry/ pattern) because HSCE-001 Section 20 (HSCE-REQ-042, unamended by this repair) already declines a creation-registry marker for this single-artifact-per-evidence_id store -- introducing one now would both reopen an out-of-scope section and add a second persistent state machine (claim lifecycle, orphan-claim handling, claim-vs-envelope crash recovery) the repair's own minimality principle disfavors when a smaller primitive (a single os.link call, simultaneously the exclusivity check and the publication act) already suffices. Froze the concurrency state machine (ABSENT to CANONICAL(bytes), never CANONICAL(A) to CANONICAL(B) for differing bytes), winner semantics (first successful os.link call, not first exists() check, not first temp-file creation, not first hardware touch), loser semantics (symlink check, then byte-compare against the established canonical envelope), identical- and differing-concurrent-writer outcomes, many-writer generalization (each os.link attempt is independently exclusive against the filesystem, not against other writers' in-process state), crash-before/after/during-publish semantics, and unsupported-filesystem fail-closed behavior, all cross-referencing the unamended symlink rules (HSCE-REQ-057/058) and canonical serialization (HSCE-REQ-053) rather than restating or reinterpreting them. Folded in Finding F-1 (non-blocking): corrected HSCE-REQ-078's self-referential requirement count from 78 to 79 (HSCE-REQ-079 already existed in Section 40 at v1.0 freeze time; no requirement was renumbered, added, or removed). Folded in Finding F-2 (non-blocking): the repaired HSCE-REQ-052 no longer claims literal unmodified reuse of rollback_approval_evidence.py::_write_atomic_json (which lacks the symlink checks HSCE-REQ-057/058 require) -- it now explicitly states it mirrors that helper's temp-file-in-same-directory discipline/technique only, closing F-2 as a byproduct of the F-3 repair rather than through a separate wording patch. Folded in Observation Obs-2 (non-blocking): added attack-matrix item 21 to HSCE-001 Section 38, the AG3 original_commit_sha-resolution-failure analogue of item 20's AG5 ecp_id-resolution-failure case -- maps to the existing operation_not_found error_type and exit code 2, no new error vocabulary needed. HSCE-001 moves from v1.0 (Phase 149O.9) to v1.1 (this phase), via new Section 44 (repair confirmation, mirroring this repository's IWC-001 v1.0-to-v1.1 Section 24 precedent for a contract-text Blocking-finding repair) and Section 45 (post-repair next-phase recommendation); every other v1.0 section -- CLI grammar, locators, envelope schema, evidence-ID formula, error vocabulary, storage layout, lookup semantics, and 11 of the 12 security invariants (SC-7's own statement, not its mechanism, is unchanged) -- is carried forward byte-unchanged, independently reconfirmed via requirement-ID sequentiality (79, unchanged) and a targeted self-consistency search for every remaining os.replace/check-then/overwrite reference (all seven remaining occurrences explicitly name it as the superseded mechanism, none as a current winner-publication primitive). 149O.10-F-3 is explicitly REPAIRED AT CONTRACT LEVEL, PENDING INDEPENDENT RE-VERIFICATION -- this repair phase does not independently close it and does not call HSCE-001 VERIFIED. Adapted the existing 149O.10 independent-verification suite: two current-tree assertions that would otherwise spuriously fail against the repaired v1.1 text (the '78 not 79' miscount check, the 'exactly 20 attack items' count) were converted to pinned historical/documentary checks against the HSCE-001 v1.0 freeze commit (3ad4e839) rather than deleted, preserving 149O.10's original findings as an explicit historical record; a third test (contract-text-unmodified-by-149O.10) was re-pinned to the 149O.9-to-149O.10 commit range rather than a generic working-tree diff, so it continues to document 149O.10's own boundary instead of spuriously failing against this later, authorized repair; the two tests independently confirming the underlying, unchanged _write_atomic_json production helper's TOCTOU-racy structure were left untouched, since that helper is not modified by this contract-only repair and remains accurate documentation of why the repair was necessary; all 87 other tests in that suite were left unmodified. New dedicated suite tests/test_phase_149o_10_1_hsce_001_narrow_contract_repair.py: 43 passed -- independently verifies version 1.1, requirement count 79, the repaired HSCE-REQ-052's hard-link algorithm text (winner/loser/crash/unsupported-filesystem semantics, no-delete-then-create prohibition, symlink cross-reference), unchanged SC-7 statement and all twelve security invariants, unchanged error vocabulary and evidence-store layout, the added AG3 attack-matrix item, finding dispositions (F-1/F-2 CLOSED, 149O.10-F-3 REPAIRED AT CONTRACT LEVEL not independently closed, Obs-2 CLOSED), and production/HATP-001/RAE-001 boundaries, plus a model-level (contract-text-structural, not filesystem-implementation-level, since no signing-ceremony implementation exists yet) concurrency test confirming the frozen algorithm's decision structure cannot let two writers both become canonical winner. 149O.9's own suite (60 passed) and the adapted 149O.10 suite (89 passed) both reconfirmed unaffected -- 132 passed total across the three HSCE-001 phase suites. Targeted regression sweep (pytest -k 'hatp or rollback or permission_broker or 149o_9 or 149o_10', excluding the pre-existing fido2-import collection failure): 2956 passed, 3 skipped, 10 failed -- independently re-verified via git-stash-clean comparison to be the identical pre-existing 10-item failure set 149O.10 itself already found, disclosed, and left unremediated (out of scope); not introduced by this phase. Fast Green: 4590 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed -- byte-identical to 149O.9's and 149O.10's own Fast Green baseline, confirming no collateral regression from this contract-text/test-only phase. No production code modified. HATP-001 v1.0 and RAE-001 v1.0 remain byte-unchanged. B-149O-1..4 remain INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED AT HATP-GATED AUTHORITY BOUNDARY -- SYSTEM EXECUTION CLOSURE DEFERRED. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable. Full detail in docs/PHASE_149O_10_1_HSCE_001_NARROW_CONTRACT_REPAIR.md. Recommended next phase: 149O.10.2, HSCE-001 Atomic No-Clobber Repair Independent Re-Verification.
